## Task list {#task-list}


### [F01 - fuel-component separation and model exploration](task-f01.qmd) {#f01}

**Status: Completed - analytical record.**

The [component definitions](task-f01.qmd#tbl-fuel-component-dictionary) separate vegetation components and pre-PCT litter/duff, omitting post-PCT forest-floor estimates. The [executable analytical sequence](task-f01.qmd#publication-execution) integrates derivation, exploration, candidate-fitting code, and complete CSV evidence; shared helpers are defined inline and saved for later tasks. The [model-review register](task-f01.qmd#rendered-provisional-model-review-register) reports provisional AIC leaders, not final selections. Prediction, inference, and display decisions belong to [RD04](task-rd04.qmd#rd04-inference-review); the task pages own calculation order and selective recomputation. Runs solely in the locked publication environment from committed thesis exports; current outputs and in-stage computational checks define the workflow. Quarto can recompute this whole task independently or render its saved evidence.


### [RD04 - fuel phase and PCT display](task-rd04.qmd) {#rd04}

**Status: Figure complete; publication table accepted.**

The [nine-panel inventory](task-rd04.qmd#completed-output) reports phase-specific mean fuel loads and a matched woody contrast. The [inference review](task-rd04.qmd#rd04-inference-review) distinguishes model changes, random-effect integration, and unmatched thesis component definitions. The [accepted supplementary table](task-rd04.qmd#fuel-companion-table) presents all 60 estimates from the canonical CSV. Woody change uses the joint phase model and its pre/post covariance. Saved computational checks support the implementation; model adequacy and the RT03 narrative remain under review. F01 supplies the provisional fitted models. RD04 can render saved results or recompute from those fits in the locked publication environment.


### [RD02 - regeneration basal area display](task-rd02.qmd) {#rd02}

**Status: Separate models selected; displays pending review.**

The [thesis-results figure](task-rd02.qmd#rd02-01) reproduces original zero-effect means and intervals; the [statistical framework](task-rd02.qmd#rd02-inference-review) distinguishes the current integrated target. One [consolidated sensitivity figure](task-rd02.qmd#rd02-04) compares joint and separate configurations, with supporting tables folded. The [model decision](task-rd02.qmd#rd02-review-recommendation) retains separate species models for biological interpretation despite stronger joint-model AIC support. Boundary variances, four-site uncertainty, zero-process assumptions, and the historical tail flag remain explicit limitations. RW/TO fits are reused from the authoritative four-category collection. Displays remain under review.


### [RD03 - sprout-height display](task-rd03.qmd) {#rd03}

**Status: Queued.**

The proposal reviews treatment, temporal, and 10-year redwood/tanoak sprout-height displays together, retaining the smallest set that preserves their distinct messages. The task page identifies the three thesis source figures and requires the chosen display to distinguish treatment from time without repeating the basal-area/density result.
